title: Neural Network Discovers Paired Wigner Crystal in Artificial Graphene
summary: Diffusion Monte Carlo in the first preprint version confirms the paired Wigner state at favorable energy. The calculation was initialized from learned orbitals, which limits its independence, and the evidence is theoretical rather than experimental.
ai_technology: Neural-network quantum state / quantum Monte Carlo

evidence.tested: The ledger records primary-v1 diffusion-Monte-Carlo confirmation of the paired Wigner state at favorable energy. Initialization used learned orbitals, limiting independence; this is theoretical, not experimental, evidence.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Neural-network quantum state / quantum Monte Carlo is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
